name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
☁️ Cloud Video & Remote Trimming: Download & stream from Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and direct URLs without downloading gigabytes first
📦 Playlist & Batch Packaging (.ZIP): Choose between saving separate files or bundling all items into a single .ZIP archive
📸 Carousel Multi-Slide Studio: Slide checkbox selector, photo/video filters, and 1-tap download of selected slides as files or .ZIP
📁 Custom Local Storage Location: Pick and persist your own download destination folder for both batches and single media
⚡ Multi-Threaded Queue Manager: Real-time queue speed banner & parallel throughput tracking across downloads
✓ Duplicate Detection: Instant badge notification on preview cards when media is already downloaded to local storage
🚀 Plugin Performance Optimization: Zero input lag during license activation with GPU-composited overlay and cached machine IDs
